ubo_rule.description: A UBO is a natural person who directly or indirectly owns 25% or more of the company.

certificate_of_incumbency_required_conte: The Company is in existence and in good legal standing.
Issuer identity statement including name, firm and license number if any
ownership_chart_required_statements: I declared that this is true, accurate, and up-to-date
No other natural person, whether directly or indirectly, owns 25% or more of xxx’s shares or controlling power.

base_documents.name: Certificate of Incorporation
base_documents.reason: Required for all companies; Hong Kong COI has no recency limit

base_documents.name: Certificate of Incumbency
base_documents.condition: Entity is incorporated outside Hong Kong and Singapore
base_documents.reason: Required for non-Hong Kong / non-Singapore entities and must be issued within 6 months

base_documents.name: Business Registration Certificate
base_documents.reason: Required for Hong Kong companies and must remain valid

base_documents.name: Memorandum & Articles of Association
base_documents.reason: Required constitutional document for all companies

base_documents.name: Register of Directors
base_documents.condition: Current directors are not evidenced by the primary registry document
base_documents.reason: Required when current directors are not shown in the applicable registry document

base_documents.name: Register of Members / Shareholders
base_documents.condition: Current shareholders are not evidenced by the primary registry document
base_documents.reason: Required when current shareholders are not shown in the applicable registry document

base_documents.name: Ownership Structure Chart
base_documents.reason: Required to identify ownership and UBOs, unless an approved listed/licensed-entity exemption applies

base_documents.name: Business Description
base_documents.reason: Useful context for business risk assessment; not a mandatory uploaded document

base_documents.name: Source of Funds Declaration / Confirmation
base_documents.reason: For low/medium risk, a declaration in the onboarding form or written confirmation is sufficient

hk_specific_documents.name: Non-US Person & Non-solicitation in HK Confirmation
hk_specific_documents.condition: Hong Kong company onboarding under the non-US / non-solicitation control
hk_specific_documents.reason: Required for Hong Kong registered companies when the control applies

hk_specific_documents.name: NNC1 or Latest NAR1
hk_specific_documents.reason: Provide NNC1 if incorporated less than 1 year; otherwise latest NAR1 filed within the statutory 42-day period

hk_specific_documents.name: ND2A Director Change Filing
hk_specific_documents.condition: Hong Kong director information has changed since NNC1/NAR1
hk_specific_documents.reason: Required when director information has changed

hk_specific_documents.name: Register of Members (ROM)
hk_specific_documents.condition: Hong Kong shareholder information has changed or is not current in NNC1/NAR1
hk_specific_documents.reason: Required for shareholder changes; for records older than 6 months, current information may be confirmed by email where permitted

singapore_specific_documents.name: Latest ACRA BizFile
singapore_specific_documents.reason: Required registry extract for Singapore companies

llc.name: LLC Operating Agreement
llc.reason: Required for Limited Liability Company entities

limited_partnership.name: Investment Manager / Advisor Agreement
limited_partnership.reason: Required for Limited Partnership / fund structures

limited_partnership.name: Administrator Agreement
limited_partnership.reason: Required for Limited Partnership / fund structures

trust.name: Trust Deed
trust.reason: Required for trust entities; must identify trust name, beneficiaries/classes, settlor, trustee, protector/executor and controllers

name_change.name: Certificate of Change of Name
name_change.reason: Required if any submitted document indicates a company name change

internal_forms.name: Authorization Letter
internal_forms.reason: Required to verify the authorized representative and approved contact email

internal_forms.name: Board Resolution
internal_forms.condition: Account-opening authority or signatories are not otherwise sufficiently evidenced
internal_forms.reason: Required when needed to authorize account opening, business scope or signatories

internal_forms.name: Declaration of Source of Fund/Wealth
internal_forms.reason: Required for high-risk source-of-funds / source-of-wealth assessment

Delaware.name: Good Standing Certificate
Delaware.reason: Delaware Good Standing must be issued within the last 6 months

Wyoming.name: County Clerk Search Evidence
Wyoming.reason: Wyoming has limited public records; County Clerk search is required

New York.name: Publication Proof for LLC
New York.reason: Required for New York LLC onboarding review

Washington D.C..name: Basic Business License
Washington D.C..reason: Required due to Washington D.C. local BSA controls

financial_or_user_asset_manager.name: Financial Licence / Registry Screenshot
financial_or_user_asset_manager.condition: Licensed financial institution or regulated asset manager
financial_or_user_asset_manager.reason: Required evidence of the current licence / registration

financial_or_user_asset_manager.name: Wolfsberg Questionnaire / AML Questionnaire / Acceptable AML Policy
financial_or_user_asset_manager.condition: Financial institution or entity managing client/user assets
financial_or_user_asset_manager.reason: Provide one acceptable AML framework document; this does not replace the Letter of Undertaking

financial_or_user_asset_manager.name: Letter of Undertaking
financial_or_user_asset_manager.condition: Financial institution or entity managing client/user assets
financial_or_user_asset_manager.reason: Always required for an applicable FI / asset-manager case; alternative AML documents cannot replace it

entity_shareholder.name: UBO No Other Shareholder Declaration
entity_shareholder.reason: Required when ownership structure cannot be fully traced to UBOs with >=25% beneficial ownership

worldcheck_alert.name: NCRS & PEP Form
worldcheck_alert.reason: Required when Worldcheck alert indicates no prior NCRS & PEP form on file

worldcheck_alert.name: Worldcheck Alert News Explanation
worldcheck_alert.reason: Required when prior NCRS & PEP form exists and a new Worldcheck news alert needs explanation

high_risk_customer.name: Source of Funds / Wealth Supporting Evidence
high_risk_customer.reason: Documentary proof is required for high-risk customers

high_risk_customer.name: Financial Statements / Operating Evidence
high_risk_customer.reason: Required to support source of funds for a high-risk operating entity

high_risk_customer.name: UBO / Senior Management Background Profile
high_risk_customer.reason: Provide education, industry experience and other relevant background for UBOs and senior management

documents.name: Online Identity Verification / AU10TIX
documents.condition: Passport / ID is not provided as a certified true copy
documents.reason: Required only when identity document is not CTC; completed verification is valid for 6 months

documents.name: Certified Passport / Accepted National ID
documents.reason: Each Director, AR and UBO must provide CTC passport or accepted national ID; passport should have at least 3 months validity

documents.name: Proof of Current Residential Address
documents.reason: Default maximum age is 3 months; extend to 6 months only for a documented onboarding delay

documents.name: Source of Crypto Assets / Supporting Evidence
documents.condition: Source of funds includes crypto assets
documents.reason: Required to evidence the source of crypto assets

documents.name: Other Documents, if available
documents.reason: Optional slot for additional helpful documents, including wallet address lists if available or requested for chain risk review

documents.name: Mining Proof, e.g. Antpool Observer Link
documents.condition: Source of funds includes mining proceeds

documents.name: Wallet Receiving Mining Proceeds, if available

required_documents.name: Financing Agreement
required_documents.reason: Useful evidence when financing or third-party funding requires further explanation; not mandatory by default

required_documents.name: Investor / Lender Information
required_documents.reason: Useful evidence when financing or third-party funding requires further explanation; not mandatory by default

required_documents.name: Proof of Fund Transfer
required_documents.reason: Useful evidence when financing or third-party funding requires further explanation; not mandatory by default
